## Research focus

### Green growth strategies towards the net-zero transition

My doctoral research examines **green growth strategies towards the net-zero transition in low- and middle-income countries**, with a focus on the economic and policy dimensions of climate transition.

::: {.feature-grid}

::: {.feature-card}

::: {.feature-kicker}
Climate policy
:::

### Carbon dioxide removal

Research on greenhouse-gas-removal technologies, investment pathways, uncertainty, and the policy conditions shaping deployment.

[Explore the work →](research.html#carbon-dioxide-removal)

:::

::: {.feature-card}

::: {.feature-kicker}
Development & climate
:::

### Applied microeconomics

Empirical research connecting climate and environmental questions with household, industrial, labour, and public-policy outcomes.

[Explore the work →](research.html#applied-microeconomics)

:::
